dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Yes, now that you mention it... there is one thing I have been meaning to do.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: When I was a child, my father often told me legends of the adepti. I remember that one legend in particular made mention of an adeptus's abode in Jueyun Karst.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Yes, that's right. The legend had it that adepti could drift upon beams of light, ride lightning, and leap into the sky to ascend to their abode.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: "From their lofty dwelling, they gaze to and fro. Drifting over land and sea, they know not the world below."

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: My father would have a mesmerized look on his face whenever we got to that part of the story.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: But though the story has been passed down all these years, no one has yet to ever see such an abode...

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: It has always been my dream to go and see such a place one day.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: I would even like to perform an opera there, letting adepti and people alike hear my voice echoing through the lands.

choices.text: I think I know of a place like the one you've described.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Ahem... I mean... I know that your words are sincere, it's just that you answered so quickly, and I haven't even decided what opera to perform or what costume to prepare...

choices.text: Take your time to think it over.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Thank you very much! That's most kind of you.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Alright, I have some ideas. I think for the performance, I will sing a selection about you and your dealings with the adepti...

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: As for the costume, I was hoping you could give me some creative input.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Alright, it's settled. I'll start practicing today... Actually, why not start right away — no time like the present! I must make sure this performance turns out perfect.

choices.text: I'll take you there once you've made up your mind.
We could just go to Qingyun Peak...
